question: Who among the following was appointed as the temporary Chairman of the Constituent Assembly?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Sachchidananda Sinha**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha** was chosen as the **temporary President of Constituent Assembly** as he was the eldest member.
 
• Dr Sachchidananda Sinha was the** earliest president of the Constituent Assembly.**
 
• Sachchidananda Sinha was an **Indian lawyer, parliamentarian, and reporter. **
 
• He **studied law in London** to become a lawyer. 
 
• Following his return from London, Sinha started a movement for a **distinct province of Bihar with a small group of others.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/533e82bd5f609d85b7b206c4586c964df661420ab7c49bb2a194ab20ac4c4220.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarat Chandra Bose** was an Indian lawyer and **independence campaigner.​ **
 
• **Acharya Kripalani **was an independence campaigner, Indian politician and an Educationist.
 
• **Rajagopalachari** was the** final**** Governor-General of India,** as India became a** republic in 1950.**
